shared_elements: carved stone surface with figural relief
upright anthropomorphic figure filling a tall vertical field
head/headdress at top with pendant or hanging strands
circular disc or roundel motif on the chest area
curved band or belt-like horizontal division across the lower body

justification: Both present a single frontal-to-profile anthropomorphic figure organised vertically — headgear with hanging strands above, a prominent circular disc at the chest, and a banded lower body — which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a crisp, finely incised low-relief slab with legible feathers, hands and a handled bucket, whereas B is a heavily eroded three-dimensional block whose motifs are barely readable and lack any narrative attributes, so the manner of rendering and overall impression differ sharply.
